name: B10-0578/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
Belarus has been sending weather balloons into Lithuania's airspace. Lithuania says about 600 balloons have come in since the start of 2025, forcing airports to close 16 times and affecting over 300 flights. Lithuania declared a nationwide emergency on 9 December 2025. The European Parliament says these are deliberate hostile acts, not just smuggling, and asks the European Union to impose more sanctions on Belarus and to help Lithuania protect itself.

- The Parliament asks for more EU sanctions on Belarus, including on fertilisers, rapeseed oil and salt.
- It affects Lithuania, its airports and passengers, and people in Belarus hit by sanctions.
- Next, the European Commission and member states are asked to act on sanctions and protection.
